question: Will Dario Marešić have at least one shot (on or off target) in Lincoln R. vs Hajduk on Nov 5, 2026 (17:45 UTC), regular time + stoppage time only?

model.prompt_context:

- "Yes": Wins if Dario Marešić is recorded as having at least one shot attempt (on target, off target, or blocked) during the Lincoln R. vs Hajduk match on November 5, 2026, strictly after 2026-11-04T13:36:14.576Z and at or before 2026-11-06T02:45:00.000Z, counting only actions occurring during regular time and stoppage time (excluding extra time and penalties).
- "No": Wins if Dario Marešić is recorded as having zero shot attempts during regular time and stoppage time of the same match within the same window, or if he did not appear in the match at all.

Clarifications:
- A "shot" counts any attempt registered by the official match data provider — on target, off target, or blocked — attributed to Dario Marešić during regulation (90 minutes plus any added stoppage time), excluding extra time and penalty shoot-outs.
- If Marešić is listed in the starting lineup or as a substitute but played zero minutes, he is treated as not having appeared and "No" wins.
